# Alamance ENT Audiology Clinic

> A comprehensive audiology practice in Burlington and Mebane, NC offering hearing aids, hearing loss treatment, and audiology services with 30+ years of experience.

Alamance ENT Audiology Clinic serves Alamance County with multiple clinic locations and a team of experienced audiologists. The clinic specializes in hearing evaluations, hearing aid fittings from major manufacturers (ReSound, Phonak, Starkey), and comprehensive hearing healthcare services.

## Core Services

- [Hearing Services](https://www.alamanceaudiology.com/hearing-services): Comprehensive hearing services including evaluations, fittings, and maintenance.
- [Hearing Loss Treatment](https://www.alamanceaudiology.com/hearing-loss): Hearing loss treatment options and services at Alamance ENT.
- [Types of Hearing Loss](https://www.alamanceaudiology.com/types-of-hearing-loss): Educational content on types of hearing loss including conductive and sensorineural.

## Hearing Aid Products

- [ReSound Hearing Aids](https://www.alamanceaudiology.com/hearing-aids/resound): ReSound hearing aid products including Vivia with AI technology.
- [Phonak Hearing Aids](https://www.alamanceaudiology.com/hearing-aids/phonak): Phonak hearing aid selection including Audeo Sphere Infinio models.
- [Starkey Hearing Aids](https://www.alamanceaudiology.com/hearing-aids/starkey): Starkey hearing aids with Edge AI technology and rechargeable options.
